scenarios.description: Initial loading gate before auth/status resolves
scenarios.setup: Navigate to Studio; screenshot while snapshot shows “Loading…” (same tab, do not wait for shell)
One CLI: fresh db.wave with auth, no superuser — `wave studio <path> --port 4400 --no-open` only while capturing auth-* ; stop CLI after auth batch
Second temp DB with superuser configured via API; no session cookie
Hono embed logged in (see README capture order)

scenarios.description: SQL console — empty editor, no result grid
scenarios.setup: Click Clear on SQL console before capture

scenarios.description: SQL console — result grid after a read query
scenarios.setup: Run e.g. `SELECT id, sku, title FROM products LIMIT 5;` then capture with result table visible

scenarios.description: Logs & metrics — no queries yet (empty stream)
scenarios.setup: Capture on a fresh Wave server process before any SQL/table loads in that process, or restart hono dev once for this shot first

scenarios.description: Logs & metrics — query log rows and non-zero read metrics
scenarios.setup: After running SQL (same session): e.g. products SELECT in SQL console, then open #/logs and wait for poll (~1s)

scenarios.description: Table browser — products grid with rows
Table browser — simple filter UI visible
Schema — Manage table panel on products
scenarios.setup: Click Manage on products card; snapshot shows “Manage table” before screenshot
